description: Land Title Settlement Department - Meegasthenna, Rideegama D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420047
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and location information) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership registration, title settlement, and property rights - all falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification category. There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related administrative matters present.
